items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: He played clarinet back in the thirties like Bird played alto in the forties.

ctx.x: When the switch first started, first, Cuppy had left and they had sent and got Big Green in Cuppy's place, Charlie --

items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: He would play Bird Byrd. He would play Diz, Sarah Vaughan, and people like that. So Birdland was packed and jammed that night. We opened up in Birdland and the people went crazy down there.

ctx.x: You know, Symphony Sid never played any of Duke Ellington's records, you know, at that time. He never played Louie Armstrong. He didn't play Duke Ellington. He would play Bird Byrd. He would play Diz, Sarah Vaughan, and people like that.
So Birdland was packed and jammed that night. We opened up in Birdland and the people went crazy down there.
